releaseName: PLAYERS Header Version Card + Distance Visibility Migration
message: Verdant 15.4.10 moves the Main Board version card beside PLAYERS and adds scoped distance-hiding migration for recognized Main Board and iPad fields. Validate in Unity before world publication.
notes: Places the Main Board version card next to PLAYERS with matching styling.
Attempts to disable recognized distance-based hiding fields with diagnostics for unsupported controllers.
Preserves supporter and shared-clock runtime code from 15.4.9.
Unity and UdonSharp runtime validation remain required.
